grades.reason: Describes LoongArch MUL/MULH instructions, not RISC-V; wrong ISA for the query.

grades.quote: It adds all of the instructions defined in Section 12.1, namely: MUL, MULH, MULHU, MULHSU, and (for RV64 only) MULW.
grades.reason: Names RISC-V MULH, MULHU and MULHSU as part of Zmmul, but says nothing about how they interpret operands (signed/unsigned). It gives only auxiliary context.

grades.quote: # Signed(vs2)-Unsigned multiply, returning high bits of product
grades.reason: Covers the RISC-V vector counterparts (vmulh, vmulhu, vmulhsu), not scalar MULH/MULHU/MULHSU. It does show the signed, unsigned and signed-by-unsigned operand interpretation for the high half, which is analogous but indirect.
